text: shift + click another aim when one is selected should select the connection from selected to clicked
reflection: Shift-clicking a second aim now selects the existing contribution connection between it and the currently selected aim, resolving the stored parent/child direction regardless of click order. It does not create an edge. If the aims are unrelated, existing shift-add multi-selection behavior remains unchanged.
